Eighteen comments

Guitarists beware

This tune is listed as G major, but it’s actually D mixolydian. New guitarists should be aware that if you try to resolve it to a G chord, it’s not going to work.
Now you know.
-jon

↳ Posted by Jon Kiparsky on December 2nd, 2001.
